name: Gantt bars
oneLiner: a glass project board stands up off a lit floor, task bars slide out along their rows, a today line sweeps across filling every bar behind it while the camera leans with it; the hero task counts to 100%, floods green and a check lands
say: when the speaker walks through a project schedule or says one part is finally done ('research, script, film, and the edit wrapped this week'): cut in on the plan, the check lands on the word that says done
